content: The SOME/IP transformer defined in this document shall be used as a transformer if • the attribute protocol of the TransformationTechnology is set to SOMEIP • and the attribute version of the TransformationTechnology is set to 1 • and the attribute transformerClass of the TransformationTechnology is set to serializer
